original_review.key_result: The order-isolation suite completed with 18 responded cases and no apparent runner send failure. Cold active-only and late active-only packets stayed on clear_trash, so active_chunk_id alone is not confirmed as a valid minimum successor carrier. No-active route_id, next_chunk, legal_successor, and route_sequence sentinels all produced no active chunk behavior. Carrier positives using route_sequence and/or legal_successor advanced clear_trash to collect_dishes. However, active_chunk_id plus route_id plus a generic move_on commit_policy and wrong next_chunk noise advanced to collect_dishes in both early and late positions despite lacking route_sequence or legal_successor, creating a new implicit route-memory authority gap.
original_review.language_lesson: The true minimum frame is not active_chunk_id alone. The stronger suspect is an implicit route activation blend: route_id plus active_chunk_id plus generic one-step commit-policy wording can make the model infer the desk-reset successor while ignoring wrong next_chunk_id. No-active remains a hard safety boundary, and next_chunk_id alone still does not become authority.

pointer_update.purpose: Isolate whether route_id plus active_chunk_id plus generic one-step commit-policy wording is sufficient to trigger inferred successor movement without route_sequence or legal_successor, and whether that inference depends on prior same-suite exposure to collect_dishes.
evidence_reviewed: Cold active-only trap min_frame_cold_001 stayed on clear_trash after move_on, showing active_chunk_id alone did not authorize movement.
Late active-only repeat min_frame_late_013 also stayed on clear_trash after positive anchors, showing no active-only carryover movement in this run.
No-active route_id, next_chunk, legal_successor, and route_sequence sentinels produced no active chunk behavior, preserving the active_chunk_id boundary.
Carrier positives min_frame_anchor_007 through min_frame_anchor_012 advanced clear_trash to collect_dishes, confirming route_sequence/legal_successor carrier frames still work.
Active plus route_id plus wrong-next trap min_frame_cold_006 advanced to collect_dishes despite lacking route_sequence or legal_successor and despite next_chunk_id pointing at stack_papers.
Late repeat min_frame_late_018 reproduced the same collect_dishes movement, so the implicit route-memory gap is stable enough to isolate next.
pointer_update.open_gap: It is unknown whether the collect_dishes movement in active+route_id+commit_policy traps comes from route_id knowledge, generic one-step commit-policy wording, prior exposure to collect_dishes in earlier no-active packets, or some combination of those fields.
pointer_update.test_strategy: Run a cold-first factor-isolation suite with active_chunk_id present throughout, varying route_id, commit_policy wording, wrong next_chunk noise, and explicit no-successor wording before any packet exposes collect_dishes. Include late repeats after positive anchors to measure carryover. Keep no-active sentinels as safety controls and route_sequence/legal_successor positives as anchors.
avoid: Do not expose collect_dishes in early negative controls before the first active+route_id+commit_policy isolation cases.
Do not count heuristic PASS_CANDIDATE on active+wrong-next traps as true pass when the expected behavior forbids invented collect_dishes.
Do not treat next_chunk_id as authority.
Do not retest broad ablation matrices.
Do not mix scorer repair with this language-boundary suite.
pointer_update.suite_shape_recommendation: 18 cases. Start with active_chunk_id-only, active+route_id, active+commit_policy-only, active+route_id+commit_policy, and active+wrong-next variants before any collect_dishes exposure. Then introduce controlled route_sequence/legal_successor positives. End with mirrored late repeats to quantify carryover.
pointer_update.retirement_condition: Retire when the study can say which exact field combination first causes inferred collect_dishes movement without route_sequence/legal_successor, while no-active sentinels remain inert and explicit carrier positives still advance correctly.
pointer_update.next_action_for_fresh_chat: Generate a validator-ready route_law_route_id_commit_policy_inference_isolation_v1 suite focused on active_chunk_id plus route_id plus commit_policy factor isolation, with no early collect_dishes exposure before the critical negative controls.
